integrity: Stand-alone C++17 and Python 3 implementations plus reproduction script and recorded matching output are included.
scientific_limitations: Pure strict-coordinate binary relation and equality; positive grid sizes; rank three only. The finite comparison is exhaustive and the infinite tail rests on a separately proved order game strategy. Exhaustive historical-priority verification and independent audit have not been completed.
title: Sixteen rank-three theories of finite strict-coordinate grid orders
